title: Protecting Your Security Deposit: Understanding Tenant Rights in India
description: A security deposit is legally the tenant's property, held in trust by the landlord, and cannot be arbitrarily deducted. The Model Tenancy Act, 2021, caps resi.

faq.q: Can a landlord ask for more than two months' rent as a security deposit for a residential property?
faq.a: Under the Model Tenancy Act, 2021, the security deposit for residential premises is capped at two months' rent. However, this is a model law, and its applicability depends on whether your state has adopted it. Always check your state's specific tenancy laws.

faq.q: What if my rent agreement doesn't specify the refund terms for the security deposit?
faq.a: Even without explicit terms, the landlord is legally obligated to return the deposit after legitimate deductions. In such cases, the Model Tenancy Act's guidelines (refund within one month) or standard industry practices (15-30 days) may apply. It's best to send a written request for refund.

faq.q: Can a landlord deduct for painting the entire apartment after I move out?
faq.a: Generally, no. Repainting due to normal wear and tear (e.g., faded paint, minor scuffs) is the landlord's responsibility. Deductions for painting are only permissible if the tenant caused significant damage requiring a fresh coat beyond normal use.

faq.q: What evidence do I need to prove arbitrary deductions?
faq.a: Strong evidence includes your signed rent agreement, proof of deposit payment (bank transfer records), dated photographs and videos of the property's condition at both move-in and move-out, and copies of all written communication with your landlord.

faq.q: Can I adjust my last month's rent against the security deposit?
faq.a: Unless your rental agreement explicitly allows for this, you cannot legally withhold your last month's rent, claiming it against the security deposit. Doing so might be considered a breach of contract and could complicate your deposit refund.

faq.q: How long does a landlord have to return the security deposit?
faq.a: The Model Tenancy Act, 2021, suggests the landlord should return the deposit within one month of the tenant vacating the premises. In areas where the Act is not enforced, the timeline depends on the rental agreement, but a typical timeframe is 15-30 days.

faq.q: What if the landlord refuses to provide an itemised list of deductions?
faq.a: If the landlord refuses to provide an itemised list with supporting invoices, their deductions may be considered arbitrary. You should send a legal notice demanding this information and prepare to pursue legal remedies if they remain non-compliant.
